name: זיהוי חתך חרוט – העברת משוואה ריבועית לצורה סטנדרטית (באנגלית)
questiontext:
The standard equation of a conic takes one of the following five formats:

\[ (1) \frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1, \mbox{(ellipse)}, \]

\[ (2) \frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1,\quad (3) \frac{y^2}{a^2} - \frac{x^2}{b^2} = 1, \mbox{(hyperbola)}, \]

\[ (4) y = a x^2,\quad (5) x = a y^2, \mbox{(parabola)}. \]

Reduce the following quadratic equation of a conic to one of these standard forms:

\[ {{CT:0}} . \]

Give your answer as a list containing (in this order) the format number, the value of \(a\) and the value of \(b\). In the case of a parabola, enter 0 for \(b\).

\([format,a,b]\) = [[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Complete the squares in \(x\) and in \(y\), move the constant to the right-hand side and divide by it. The signs of the two squares tell which standard form it is.
Step 1 — Grouping the terms
Collect the terms with \(y\) and the terms with \(x\), take out the coefficients of \(y^2\) and \(x^2\), and move the constant term to the right-hand side:

\[ {{CT:1}}\left({{CT:2}}\right)-{{CT:3}}\left({{CT:4}}\right)={{CT:5}} \]

Step 2 — Completing the squares
Since \({{CT:2}}={{CT:6}}-{{CT:7}}\) and \({{CT:4}}={{CT:8}}-{{CT:9}}\), the equation becomes

\[ {{CT:1}}{{CT:6}}-{{CT:3}}{{CT:8}}={{CT:5}}+{{CT:10}}-{{CT:11}}={{CT:12}} \]

Step 3 — The standard form
Dividing by \({{CT:12}}\):

\[ \frac{{{CT:6}}}{{{CT:3}}}-\frac{{{CT:8}}}{{{CT:1}}}=1 \]

The square with the plus sign is the one in \(y\), so this is a hyperbola in format (3), shifted to the centre \(({{CT:13}},{{CT:14}})\), with \(a^2={{CT:3}}\) and \(b^2={{CT:1}}\), that is \(a={{CT:15}}\) and \(b={{CT:16}}\). The answer is

\[ {{CT:17}} \]
